'''Inquisition Base''' is an area located to the left of the [[Crossroads]]. It is where the [[Keeper]] performs most of his activities.

It has a [[milestone]] that is active by default.

== Areas ==

* [[Alchemy Lab]]
* [[Garden]]
* [[Graveyard]]
* [[Morgue]]
* [[Yard]]
